entry_execution: post-only LIMIT parent at the frozen consumed boundary, five-minute GTD, contingent TP/SL

development_week.use: causal-family development only; not counted as a fresh random-week pass

causal_question: When a balanced dealing range has repeatedly traded both boundaries, does an aggressive external liquidity sweep that is replenished and closes back inside create a tradable passive retest toward equilibrium?
state_machine: freeze the completed prior auction high, low and aggressive-volume weighted equilibrium
require low path efficiency, bounded ATR-normalized width and at least two touches at both edges
require low toxicity and inefficient one-minute price impact
require directional aggressive flow to sweep one external boundary while same-side one-percent depth replenishes
require the completed sweep minute to close at least 0.05 ATR back inside
rest a five-minute post-only limit at the consumed boundary
invalidate beyond the observed sweep extreme plus 0.10 ATR
family_promotion_rule: The central 30-minute auction and at least one adjacent 20- or 45-minute auction must satisfy every gate. Only then is the unchanged 30-minute rule locked before a newly selected uncollected first BTC week.
fresh_data_rule: No fresh random-week data is collected before the revealed-week horizon plateau passes.
